description:
A hospital's surgical department is implementing structured documentation for operating room procedures. You need to create a new encounter role in the OpenMRS system so that scrub nurses can be properly identified and attributed in surgical encounter records.

Create a new encounter role with the following details:
- Name: Scrub Nurse
- Description: Nurse who assists the surgical team by handling instruments and supplies during surgical procedures

The browser is open to the OpenMRS Administration page. Navigate to the encounter role management section (under 'Encounters'), add the new role with the specified name and description, and save it.
